title: Strange bedfellows.
subject: PNN: Two rivals, eight pranks, one cow. A study of how alliances end.
preheader: Spiders and aliens hit the same two houses, then each other. The Institute has a study. It ends badly. It always does.

featuredCase.teaser: **Spiders and aliens hit the same two houses in one night, then each other.** Both teams call themselves rivals. PNN has a composite sketch, a cow with a wardrobe, and a cobweb sold in two colors. *Neither team will confirm the handshake. The handshake is in the sketch.*
featuredCase.hook: including the route comparison and the sketch desk's composite

image.alt: A pencil-and-charcoal police sketch on aged paper headed PNN RECONSTRUCTION: ARACHNID + EXTRATERRESTRIAL. A fuzzy black spider in a fedora and bandit mask shakes hands with a smiling gray alien in a trench coat. Behind them, a corkboard with red string links drawings of a spider web, a flying saucer, a roll of toilet paper, and a cow with a mohawk. A red stamp reads COLLUSION?

tickerItems.text: Edition 009: a study finds alliances end in betrayal, usually over a cow. The Black-and-Green Alliance has a cow.

sections.kicker: SPECIAL REPORT / THE INSTITUTE FOR COLLABORATIVE MISCHIEF
sections.heading:
Alliances always end in betrayal.
(A longitudinal study of the Black-and-Green Alliance, still in progress.)

runs.text: reviewing every alliance in recorded history,
and several that were recorded only by the people in them.
Its finding, in the Institute's own words:
'It ends badly. Always. Usually over a cow.'
The Institute calls this 'the opening paragraph of every betrayal.'
forty-one alliances, observed from a hedge.
Forty ended in betrayal. The forty-first is still in progress, and has a cow.
Exhibit A is the Bureau's own paperwork.
Its final Mission Log reports that the Bandits were
'thought they were trailing victims, but they were being hunted by the Bureau the entire time.'
This is the part of the study where the alliance falls apart.
It happened in the fourth log, in public, with an emoji.
They are a spider team. They wait very still. PNN suspects they are already building something.
PNN also suspects it will be late.

sections.heading: The numbers, such as they are

items.text: **Alliances that end in betrayal, per the Institute.** *The other 3% ended too fast to count.*
**Median lifespan of a 'cosmic lockdown.'** *Set by the Area 51 Bureau in PNN-013. Broken by a cow.*

**Pranks that night, versus houses hit by both teams.** *One Pyro Posse house and one Tightie Whities house. The Silver Bullets were split down the middle. Teams have many households, which Clueso has since had explained to him.*
**Times the Bureau's logs mention the Bandits.** *One dropped a B, which stings a team that took the longest to pick its name. Mentions of the pink team: zero. Clueso has noticed.*

**Teams visited by three different teams in two nights: the Whities, the Bullets, and the Posse.** *The pink team went first. The Bandits and the Bureau followed. Lawn decorations have not had a night off.*
**Cow with a full wardrobe.** *Briefs, a mohawk, a flame brand. It has not testified. It has also not been asked to take off the mohawk.*
**Teams that admitted to the alliance.** *Teams that denied it with matching enthusiasm: two. Clueso says that is also a pattern.*

runs.text: an alliance lasts exactly as long as it takes someone to strap the other team's mascot to a cow.
Duration in this case: one night. Cows: one, plus staff.

sections.heading:
The seven stages of an alliance falling apart.
(Teams in stage four may experience cows.)

runs.text: Two teams agree to 'share the neighborhood.' One brings toilet paper. The other brings toilet paper, but green. The sketch desk has the handshake on paper.

Eight pranks is a lot of cobweb. Someone has a coupon. Someone else has the receipt. This is how black webbing on one porch and neon green webbing on one door came to be the same stretchy product. Same aisle. Different color.
The Silver Bullets were divided between the partners, down the middle, like a pie. The Bullets, who are in bed by eight
, were not consulted. Nobody argues over the first pie.

The partners visit each other's houses. This is called 'hitting a rival.' It is also called 'checking on the dishes.' Each team got one visit, exactly as Rule 2 requires. The paperwork is immaculate. Clueso is deeply suspicious of immaculate.
'Hijacked their signature spider and strapped it directly onto the cow.' The spider was not asked. The cow was not asked either, but the cow has been through worse
, where it was branded PP and left with a cowboy.

'Black Webb neutralised, cow extracted, Green Team supreme.' The Bureau has issued four verdicts. Verdicts are PNN's job. PNN has filed a complaint against the Bureau. It was filed under 'Cosmic Lockdown,' where nothing has been seen for four days.
Neither team touched the pink house. The Institute classifies this as the only point of total agreement in the alliance. Clueso classifies it as fear. The Institute classifies Clueso as reasonable.

Duration: never. Cause of collapse: wrong night, wrong night, and, per PNN-012, wrong night again.
Duration: one night. Cause of collapse: pending, but the cow is nervous.

sections.kicker: A NOTE FROM INSPECTOR CLUESO'S OFFICE
sections.heading:
I called it.
(Nobody listened. Again.)

runs.text: Inspector Clueso has spent seventeen cases waiting for two teams to get together and make his job easy.
They hit eight houses, left no footage, and posted four mission logs.
He considers this a confession in four parts.
PNN has filed the request under Seasonal Decorations.
He would also like it noted that
neither team touched the pink house.
He reads this as fear. PNN reads it as the best decision of the alliance.
had already finished the neighborhood the night before and was, as far as Clueso can prove, resting.
He has asked for the minutes of that, too.
